1.consolidated_definition: El espíritu se refiere a la parte inmaterial o esencial de un ser vivo, considerado como su alma o principio vital.
1.en_consolidated_definition: The spirit refers to the immaterial or essential part of a living being, considered as its soul or vital principle.
